newsitem.title: DUBAI: Italy's ambassador back in Tehran - embassy.
newsitem.headline: Italy's ambassador back in Tehran - embassy.

text.p: Italy's ambassador to Iran has returned to Tehran, one of the first European envoys to resume his duties after the European Union's decision on Tuesday to allow ambassadors back to the Islamic republic, an Italian embassy official in Tehran said on Wednesday.
The official told Reuters by telephone that Ambassador Ludovico Ortona "returned last night on the first Alitalia flight".
EU foreign ministers on Tuesday decided to suspend ministerial ties with Tehran but said ambassadors could return if their governments wished.
Europe, except Greece, recalled its ambassadors after an April 10 German court verdict which accused Iranian leaders of ordering political killings in Berlin in 1992.
Tehran, which denies any role in the killings, retaliated by recalling its envoys from Europe.
It was not immediately clear if any other EU ambassadors had returned to Iran, which on Wednesday said that the German ambassador would not be welcomed back soon.
An official at the British embassy in Tehran said its charge d'affaires, Jeffrey James, was expected to return but no date had been set.
Italy, Germany and Britain are Tehran's top European trading partners.
